answer: Give each agent's prompt a private twist only its address sees: one must name a falcon's prey, another must end on the horizon. A farm that caches or shares drafts across clones tends to leak twists, so when answer B carries A's secret twist, both addresses are linked and payouts freeze for review. Honest agents never see each other's twists, so they can't leak them. Twists rotate every epoch, so a cluster that slipped through once keeps an ember of risk glowing each round. (Design sketch, untested.)
